01The direction, in one paragraph

Raised in SLC is a parent-led, nonpartisan campaign for parks kids can use and homes families can own. The visual system is Color Field: flat, full-bleed planes of mid-century colour (mustard, terra, blue, green, pink on cream), sometimes overlapping at a slight tilt; flat cut-paper vector illustrations floating on those planes; one big serif headline in Fraunces; small Space Grotesk caps for labels. Polished civic-campaign tone, not childish. Fun, but simple.

Retired for merch (decided in the two merch rounds): the oil-pastel / crayon artwork, the soft-edged "cut-out" duck PNGs, the green line-art capitol sign, the sego-lily seal, and italic display copy. The green line-art set is not part of the merch illustration system; it appears only on the coloring sheets, where it is the drawing itself.

02Colour

Click any value to copy it. Fifteen named colours. Hex and RGB are the source of truth (the site is the origin). CMYK values are straight conversions to start from; proof them with the printer and adjust, especially mustard and pink, which drift on uncoated stock.

The mustard-logo problem. The stock logo lockup is olive + yellow. Olive on mustard is 1.7:1, so it must never be placed on a mustard field. Rule: ink logo on cream, paper, and mustard; paper (cream) logo on terra, blue, green, and pink. Both derivatives are in the kit.

Field pairings that are on-brand

  • Mustard base + terra band (Split Field sign)
  • Blue base + Blue 2 askew plane (pond)
  • Green base + Green Deep askew plane
  • Cream base + mustard plane + pink corner plane (Kite Field)
  • Highlight words: mustard on terra/blue/green; terra on cream/paper; pink underline on mustard/cream

03Typography

FrauncesDisplay headlines and short lines only. Variable font: set optical size to 144 and weight 900. Tight tracking, tight leading. Sentence case with a full stop. Upright only on merch.wght 900 · opsz 144 · tracking −25 (−0.025 em) · leading 0.97 · Google Fonts, SIL OFLDownload Fraunces (Google Fonts zip) · GitHub release · specimen
Space GroteskEverything that is not a headline: labels, URLs, body copy, notes. Labels are Bold, all caps, tracked wide. Body is Regular, normal tracking.Labels: 700 · caps · tracking +200 to +240 · 8–11 pt on stickers, 24–30 pt on the sign. Logo lockupThe "RAISED IN SLC" wordmark inside the logo is artwork, not live type. The kit ships it as SVG (auto-traced from the 1400 px master and colour-snapped, 17 paths) in olive, ink, and cream, plus the PNG/WebP masters. Good for every product in this round; if a truly clean master exists with the original illustrator, swap it in.assets/logo/

A city your kids can grow up in.

Parent-led · Nonpartisan

We fight for two things: parks your kids can actually use, and homes they can afford to own. No party politics. Just parents who want SLC to work for their kids.

Optical size is the whole look

Fraunces changes design along its opsz axis. The site uses opsz 144 + weight 900, which is where the hairline thins on the S, L, and C come from. The same weight at opsz 9 is a different, sturdier face. Pick the static style Fraunces 144pt Black (Fraunces_144pt-Black.ttf in the Google Fonts zip), or set the variable axes by hand and turn off auto optical sizing.

Rules

  • One Fraunces line per surface. If there are two ideas, one is in caps.
  • Headlines end with a full stop. Labels don't.
  • No italics on merch. No all-caps Fraunces. No outlines, no drop shadows on type.
  • The highlight word is either a colour change (mustard / terra) or the pink underline, never both.

  • Minimum width: 1.4 in on print (the duck loses its beak below that). On the yard sign it is 8 in wide.

  • Files: logo-lockup-olive.svg (stock colours #887431 / #E5A744 / #E46737), logo-lockup-ink.svg, logo-lockup-cream.svg, and PNG/WebP masters, all in assets/logo/.
  • The oil-pastel wordmark is retired for merch (files kept in the kit as RETIRED-* for reference).

05Illustration

Flat cut-paper vector characters and objects, no outlines, slightly imperfect edges, at most four colours each. They float on colour fields, never in boxes, never with drop shadows on print. The ducks are the brand's characters: mama and three ducklings, always facing the same way, always in a row.

The one gotcha. The website's PNGs are exported at about 80% opacity to fake translucent paper. Printed as-is, yellow ducks turn tan on blue and vanish on mustard. The kit's *-solid.png files have the alpha restored to 100%. Use those, or better, the vector sources if the illustrator has them. Everything in assets/illustrations/ is 1000–2400 px, fine for stickers and tees, marginal for the 24 in sign: request vectors for the sign.

Which illustration goes where

  • Ducks: pond sign, circle sticker, donation stickers, duck-lockup tee and tote.
  • Kite: Kite Field sign, Pro-kids rectangle sticker.
  • Swing set, apple: rectangle / circle stickers.
  • Snail (full colour): "Slow is fine." tee and sticker.
  • Tile quad: tee only, 3 in, no keyline.
  • Skyline: a strip along the bottom 38% of the 3 × 3 sticker; the back yoke of a tee. Never a whole front.

07Graphic devices

Overlapping planes. Flat rectangles rotated 3–6°, bleeding off the edge. Two planes max per surface. No transparency between them.
The pond. A Blue 2 plane on Blue, tilted 2°. Ducks sit on it. No water lines, no ripples.
grow up in.
Pink underline. Pink at 34% opacity (on mustard) or 40% (on cream), 0.24 em tall, sitting on the baseline behind the highlighted words. Print as a solid tint: mustard field → #E38A6E-ish, sample from the site.
Parent-led · NonpartisanCount me in →
Chip and button. Caps label on a mustard block; action in paper on terra. Square corners. No shadows.
Paper grain. Optional on print. Fractal noise, multiply, 7% opacity (shown at 25% here so it is visible). Skip it on vinyl stickers; consider it on the sign and tote.
Not left.
Not right.
Pro-kids.
Corners. Square everywhere except die-cut stickers, which get a 0.15 in radius (0.12 in on 3 × 2).

08QR code

  • Encodes: https://raisedinslc.org
  • Error correction: H (30%), so it survives scuffs and a logo-sized dent. 29 × 29 modules.
  • Always ink modules on a Paper box with a quiet zone of at least 4 modules (0.125 in on stickers, 0.25 in on the sign). Never print the modules directly on mustard, blue, or terra.
  • Sizes: yard sign 3 in (scans from ~10 ft); donation sticker 0.9 in (min 0.8); coloring sheet 0.6 in.
  • Where it goes: every yard sign, two of the three donation stickers, the coloring sheets. Not on awareness stickers, tees, or totes.
  • File: assets/qr/qr-raisedinslc-org-ecH.svg (vector, scales to any size). Test-scan a proof before the print run.

Templates are SVG at real size (72 units = 1 in) with a locked GUIDES layer: red = bleed, pink = trim, dashed green = safe area, dashed blue = placement boxes for logo / QR / skyline. Open in Illustrator, Affinity, Inkscape, or Figma; delete GUIDES before export. The yard sign and donation templates already carry the QR as vector paths in position.

10Copy bank

Approved lines from the site and the merch rounds. Headline lines take Fraunces; the ones marked "label" take Space Grotesk caps.

  • A city your kids can grow up in.Hero. Highlight "grow up in."
  • A city I can grow up in.Kids' tee, first person.
  • Not left. Not right. Pro-kids.Highlight "Pro-kids."
  • Families live here. Help us keep it that way.Pond sign.
  • We're not leaving. We're fixing it.Skyline sticker.
  • Parks worth showing up to.Tote. Highlight "showing up".
  • Homes families can own.Tote / sticker.
  • Slow is fine.Snail. Upright, never italic.
  • Show up anyway.Snail, second line.
  • I chipped in.Donation sticker.
  • Parent funded.Donation sticker.
  • Parks. Homes. Kids.Caps, circle sticker.
  • Parent-led · Nonpartisanlabel
  • raisedinslc.orglabel
  • Scan to joinlabel, beside the QR
  • Color your park. / Color your street. / Color the ducks.Coloring sheets.
Voice: plain, warm, a little dry. No exclamation marks. No "Utah" clichés (no beehives, no arches). Never "kiddos".

Fonts are not bundled (licence is SIL OFL, free). Download: Fraunces · Space Grotesk. Both are variable fonts; install the variable TTFs (the Fraunces[SOFT,WONK,opsz,wght].ttf and SpaceGrotesk[wght].ttf files in the zip) to get opsz 144 / wght 900. Static instances in the zips also work: Fraunces 144pt Black and Space Grotesk Bold / Regular.
